queries_run: Arm Holdings China export control tariff 2026
semiconductor Section 232 tariff 2026 chip licensing IP exemption

findings.claim: Arm 20-F：Neoverse V 系列效能達美英出口管制門檻，對中國出貨需出口許可，且難取得；公司改授權未超門檻的其他 CPU 核心以滿足客戶需求。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2026 Item 3 Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: For example, our Neoverse V series processors meet or exceed performance thresholds under U.S. and U.K. export control regimes and thereby trigger U.S. and U.K. export license requirements prior to export and delivery to customers in the PRC.

findings.claim: 20-F：2025 年美國發布先進運算晶片、HBM、GAAFET 等出口管制規則並增列實體清單；公司稱不太可能取得部分高效能 Neoverse 核心的美英出口許可，可能降低營收並使產品路線圖不確定。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2026 Item 3 Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: it is unlikely that we would be able to obtain a U.S. or U.K. export license for certain high performance compute cores in the Neoverse series processor family. This and any similar limitations could also reduce our revenues and cause significant uncertainty in our products roadmap

findings.claim: 20-F：2026-02-20 最高法院推翻部分 IEEPA 關稅；2025 年關稅曾對半導體與電子等策略產業給予豁免；Section 232 半導體調查於 2026-01-15 起對 NVIDIA H200、AMD MI325X 課關稅；2026 年啟動 Section 301 半導體調查。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2026 Item 3 Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: The investigation resulted in an announcement of tariffs, effective January 15, 2026, applicable to NVIDIA H200 and AMD MI325X chips and systems incorporating such chips.

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋未找到點名 Arm 的關稅專文；Arm 為 IP 授權／版稅模式，關稅影響主要為間接（客戶產品價格與需求）。
